questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.
options: Only after the rain stopped did they continue the journey.
Only after the rain stopped they continued the journey.
Only after the rain stopped, they continued the journey.
Only after the rain stopped: they continued the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did they continue the journey.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?
options: It was John who broke the window yesterday.
It was John that broke the window yesterday.
It was John which broke the window yesterday.
It was John, who broke the window yesterday.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window yesterday.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly uses the third type of conditional sentence to discuss hypothetical situations in the past with unreal consequences.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would attend it now.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it then.
If I had known about the meeting, I would attend it then.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it then.

questions.question: Which sentence properly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?
options: The committee recommended that all members attend the conference.
The committee recommended that all members attends the conference.
The committee recommended that all members attending the conference.
The committee recommended that all members attended the conference.
questions.answer: The committee recommended that all members attend the conference.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses ellipsis to omit understood words, maintaining grammatical coherence.
options: She doesn't like coffee, but he does.
She doesn't like coffee, but he does too.
She doesn't like coffee, but he does either.
She doesn't like coffee, but he does as well.
questions.answer: She doesn't like coffee, but he does too.
